summary: A promotional banner or card, usually pointing out a new feature with an image and a call-to-action button.
description: A promotional callout element with an optional heading, image, actions and support link, and an optional dismiss button.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of promo, either "default" or "vibrant". Determines the colors of the promotional element.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The heading of the promo element.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: The message of the promo element.

attributes.name: imageSrc
attributes.description: The main image of the promo element.

attributes.name: imageAlignment
attributes.description: How the image should be aligned. Can be "start", "end", or "center".

attributes.name: imageWidth
attributes.description: How big the image is sized. Can be "default", "small" or "large".

attributes.name: imageDisplay
attributes.description: Whether the image touches the edge of the promo or has a little padding around it. Can be "cover" or "padded".

attributes.name: dismissable
attributes.description: Whether the promo can be dismissed via a close button.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Action controls (e.g. a moz-button) shown after the message.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: A moz-support-link shown after the message/actions.

events.name: promo:user-dismissed
events.description: Fired when the promo is dismissed by the user via the close button. Cancelable; if defaultPrevented, the element does not remove itself.

usage:
<moz-promo heading="Try this feature" message="A short description of the feature." dismissable>
  <moz-button slot="actions">Get started</moz-button>
</moz-promo>
